title: On Comparing the two records line by line
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：compare　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 compare 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the foreman ① compared the two records line by line without complaint, and every worker in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the foreman ② compares the two records line by line with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ compare the two records line by line at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ compared the two records line by line before — a line in the sheet for May 1985 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Comparing the two records line by line without complaint, the foreman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ compare the lake to a shut eye with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Compare the lake to a shut eye at once and never mention it again.

By 1998 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the sheet, and a new worker from the next site ⑧ compares the lake to a shut eye without complaint every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ramp, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ compared the two records line by line again when nobody else would.

⑩ To compare the two records line by line, my mother said in 2003, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody compares the two records line by line with great care again and somebody must compare the two records line by line without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 比较（一般过去式 compared the two records line by line：1991 年工头头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 比较（一般现在 compares the two records line by line：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 比较（不定式 to compare the two records line by line：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 比较（过去完成时 had compared the two records line by line：1985 年五月的施工单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 比较（动名词 comparing the two records line by line 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 比作（compare the lake to a shut eye：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去比作把湖比作一只闭着的眼）
G. v. 比作（compare the lake to a shut eye：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 比较（后段两处：新来的工人照例 compares the lake to a shut eye，而母亲又一次 compared the two records line by line）

answers.why: compare 意为“比较”，1991 年工头毫无怨言地比较把两条记载逐行比对，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 compared。
compare 意为“比较”，自那以后工头小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 compares。
compare 意为“比较”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯比较把两条记载逐行比对”，此处为不定式 to compare the two records line by line。
compare 意为“比较”，施工单里 五月 那行字说明早在 1998 年之前就有人比较过，故用过去完成时 had compared。
compare 意为“比较”，工头说“比较把两条记载逐行比对这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 comparing the two records line by line 作主语。
compare 意为“比作”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去比作把湖比作一只闭着的眼”，should ever 之后用原形 compare the lake to a shut eye。
compare 意为“比作”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻比作把湖比作一只闭着的眼（compare the lake to a shut eye at once），以后再也不要提起。
compare 意为“比较”，新来的工人每个班次都照例比作把湖比作一只闭着的眼，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 compares。
compare 意为“比较”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地比较把两条记载逐行比对，用一般过去式 compared 叙述。
compare 意为“比较”，结尾那句是母亲 2003 年的话：要比较把两条记载逐行比对，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 compare 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the foreman compared the two records line by line without complaint, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the foreman compares the two records line by line with great care whenever the site asks.
Comparing the two records line by line without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever compare the lake to a shut eye with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next site compares the lake to a shut eye without complaint every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother compared the two records line by line again, and the site remembered that half.
